comment: The deployment half of the fact-graph binding: which fact graph and vertex type serve this semantic graph. The per-metric / per-dimension property binding and the question synonyms now live on the semantic graph's own nodes (graphProperty and alias on tpc-h-analytics), written by the same TpchDataAgentDataset that writes the fact graph, so the two can no longer drift. This file keeps only what the model cannot know itself: where the facts live. A missing dimensions/metrics/synonyms key is the migration marker - the runner reads the model's graphProperty first and falls back to this file for a graph that has not been re-seeded.
